body: Credibility-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.90 (naive sector base rate 0.92) that: Simpson FY2026 GAAP consolidated operating margin is >=20.0%. Probability set only by the pre-stated rule (research_notes/Promise tracker pilot/US_INDUSTRIALS_peer_comparison.md section 5 = AUTO_COMPONENTS_peer_comparison.md section 5, unchanged): p0 = 0.92 (leave-one-out peer strict delivery rate, category 'margin', n=12); SAC -7.0 pts x weight 0.259 (N=7) -> p = 0.90. Evidence: Q3-2026 call (26-Oct-2026): FY2026 operating margin 20.0-20.5% incl. an ~$11 mn Q4 land-sale gain (Feb guide 19.5-20.5%, Jul 19.7-20.5%). FY2025 19.6% (XBRL 458.1/2,330). Resolution: YES if FY2026 OperatingIncomeLoss / revenue >= 20.0%, to one decimal, both from the FY2026 Form 10-K XBRL (as first reported). Source: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts (FY2026 10-K). Resolve by 2027-03-15; score with Brier vs the base rate, to test whether the credibility adjustment adds skill.

data.adjustment_applied: p0 = 0.92 (leave-one-out peer strict delivery rate, category 'margin', n=12); SAC -7.0 pts x weight 0.259 (N=7) -> p = 0.90
data.adjustment_rule: p0 = leave-one-out pooled STRICT delivery rate (specificity-weighted share 'delivered'; partly=0) of the other 3 peers in the promise's category (all-category peer rate if <8 peer promises in that category). p = clip(p0 + N/(N+20) x SAC/100, 0.05, 0.95), N = company's scored promises, SAC in points (credit basis: delivered 1, partly 0.5; categories with n<5, or with <2 peers having data, pooled). P(base) = p0.
data.base_rate_reasoning: Naive forecaster = sector delivery rate for 'margin' promises among the other US industrials peers (strict: delivered only, specificity-weighted; n=12). No company-specific information.
data.resolution_rule: YES if FY2026 OperatingIncomeLoss / revenue >= 20.0%, to one decimal, both from the FY2026 Form 10-K XBRL (as first reported).

title: Paper call: Simpson FY2026 GAAP consolidated operating margin is >=20.0%
